introduction.title: Introduction

paragraphs.text:
What comes to mind when you look at the title of this digital exhibition? Where do you think it takes place? 
Take a guess at the kinds of images and objects we're about to uncover.
To get started, let’s dive into the exhibition’s rich Southeast Asian roots, which will serve as our map before we explore how it weaves together animals, nature, and culture.

trails_section.title: Trails
trails_section.tagline: Step beyond traditional gallery walls and dive into the animal trails!
trails_section.paragraph_1: In this borderless digital world, Southeast Asia’s nature and culture collide across 121 incredible exhibits—from 2nd-century BCE artifacts to modern finds. Journey through 11 natural species and 5 mythical creatures spanning 5 dynamic zones and 17 interconnected trails.
trails_section.paragraph_2: Forget rigid physical galleries! Here, you can explore the deeper meanings of animals, peoples and places across multiple zones simultaneously, revealing how nature shapes human culture—and vice versa—in one seamless view. Ready to explore? Hop onto the trail of your favorite animal, and keep your eyes peeled as you leap between zones of the exhibition. Your adventure begins now!
